sketches.mechanism: An uninhabited datatype with an empty case expression is exhaustive, allowing a total function from the impossible value to any type.
sketches.resonance: If the impossible ever arrived, it could become anything, precisely because it cannot arrive.

sketches.mechanism: ARC zeroes a weak optional reference to nil when the last strong reference to its object leaves scope.
sketches.resonance: A bond that refuses ownership remains only as emptiness when the other is gone.

sketches.mechanism: scope(exit) schedules a statement to run when the enclosing scope exits, even through an early return.
sketches.resonance: Some obligations wait at the threshold and act after the decision to leave has already been made.
